title: Rose D NDE 2483
content: I was extremely ill, dehydrated, and must have fallen into an unconscious state. All I remember is being in a place of bright light. There was another presence with me. I do not remember speaking but knew what this other being was saying. I did not see my own body or anyone else there at all - just light. I do not remember any exact words but the essence of what was I was being told. I asked if this was heaven and was told, 'Yes, if that is what you want to call the afterlife.' I responded, 'I do not believe in Heaven (per say) or an afterlife.' I was told I was wrong. I had been in so much pain and was so ill but not in this place. The euphoria, peace and serenity were incomprehensible. I actually argued with this other presence by stating that people need to catch a few seconds of this place. To give them some hope and some peace. That there is a really big mess on earth. This being apparently has a sense of humor and responded with something like you are not supposed to argue with the creator or I will have to put you in time out. But even then, I was not afraid. This entity then gently and warmly assured me that every single person was given enough information for him or her to make the right choices. Free will was a right not to be given up lightly. And sometimes seeing is not even enough for believing. Remember kindness, selflessness and love towards others will always guide you in the right directions. If you do not get it right, you will always have another change. You are not finished and have more work to do. Then I woke up on the floor with the same euphoria, sweet smell and pain gone for about five more minutes. Then my illness came back. But I cannot forget the experience and feel I am supposed to somehow share it. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: January 31, 2006 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Illness Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening How do you consider the content of your experience? Mixed Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Less consciousness and alertness than normal At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I was unconscious during the entire experience. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I did not have a body and could not see anything but white light. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I did not hear at all in a normal everyday aspect. I did not hear any words. I cannot even really describe it since I do not understand it. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes See above. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Unfamiliar, strange place the entire place appeared to be some sort of other type of dimension What emotions did you feel during the experience? Euphoria like nothing that can be explained and peace. Also sadness for people who could not experience the rare and precious moment I had. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? Neither Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? A barrier I was not permitted to cross; or 'sent back' to life involuntarily God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate None Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Uncertain I am not religious but now feel there is a spiritual being guiding our destiny and life after death. I am not afraid of death. What is your religion now? Moderate None Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Uncertain I am not religious but now feel there is a spiritual being guiding our destiny and life after death. I am not afraid of death. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Uncertain Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? This experience will change my life forever. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Right away I told my husband and my sister. It just happened yesterday and I am still recovering from the flu. Neither one seemed that surprised. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Uncertain As a health care worker I deal with illness and death. I have heard stories from patients regarding their own experiences with the tunnel, the lights, their life flashing before them, etc. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real It does not matter to me if my experience was real or not. It only matters to me that I was given something special, a precious gift, I do not know why. And how I choose to use that gift is now up to me. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real Again I will choose to use this experience as a positive influence for the rest of my life. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

arrival.other_being_detail: Unseen presence; experiencer refers to it as possibly 'the creator' and describes it as having a sense of humor and communicating assurances about free will and kindness/love.

environment.environment_other_detail: Only white/bright light is described; experiencer calls it an unfamiliar/strange place or dimension.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: The presence said, 'You are not finished and have more work to do.'
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told to remember 'kindness, selflessness and love towards others' and that she had 'more work to do'; she felt she was supposed to share the experience.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Extremely ill and dehydrated; unconscious state; described as not considered life-threatening.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Reported loss of awareness of body and being in bright/white light with an unseen presence; no tunnel; later a barrier not permitted to cross and then waking back in body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Sweet smell upon return; pain gone for about five minutes after waking; humorous 'time out' comment attributed to the presence.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Yes, if that is what you want to call the afterlife.” / “You are not supposed to argue with the creator or I will have to put you in time out.” / “Remember kindness, selflessness and love towards others will always guide you in the right directions.” / “You are not finished and have more work to do.”
